notes: (x, row, n): BGR555 -> device format, 0x0000 -> alpha 0, stamp++

notes: (rect, mark): mark=1 -> state 2, else Release + clear; also previous page (256-wide textures)

notes: (thread, routine): pc = A54 + table[routine], sp = thread+0x80, state 1

name: Script_GetValue
notes: (thr, type, v): 0 imm, 1 r[v], 2 sp[v], 6 globals[v], else imm

notes: each frame: G+0xA5C 32 x 40-byte trigger areas vs player level/x,z; kind handler 0x738B68

notes: door transition task started by AOT_Door

notes: push vector out of a wall segment and radius vector
